description: a thin young man with long straight black hair in a deep navy blue robe down to the feet patterned with small silver constellations, a silver crescent moon emblem on the chest, a high stiff collar, a dark wooden staff topped with a black crystal held upright in the front hand, seen exactly from the side in profile, facing and walking to the right, the face, chest and hips turned to the right and not towards the viewer, only one eye showing, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
